title: Barbarossa Fishing Charters

services.name: Charter Costs
services.desc: Target one of California’s most prized gamefish with Barbarossa Fishing’s specialized Halibut charters. These exciting adventures combine technical fishing skills with the thrill of battling California’s largest flatfish in the sandy shallows and deep channels of Monterey Bay. Duration: 3 or 7 hoursPrice: $800 (3 hours) / $1,300 (7 hours)for up to 4 guests. services.name: Santa Cruz Harbor Private Charters
services.desc: Experience the thrill of fishing in one of California’s most productive waters with our Santa Cruz Harbor Private Charters. These trips are perfect for beginners and families with children, offering a comfortable introduction to saltwater fishing while maintaining the excitement that keeps seasoned anglers coming back. Your adventure will target some of the area’s most abundant and delicious fish species. Rockfish and Lingcod are available April 1st through December 31st, while Halibut fishing is open year-round but best from May through October.
